name: investor-materials
tagline_zh: BP、一页纸、财务模型、投资人备忘录——改一处，全盘同步。告别数字打架，让每一份材料都像出自同一支团队。
tagline_en: Pitch decks, memos, models—change once, sync everywhere. No more conflicting numbers across your fundraising stack.
desc_en: Create and update pitch decks, one-pagers, investor memos, accelerator applications, financial models, and fundraising materials. Use when the user needs investor-facing documents, projections, use-of-funds tables, milestone plans, or materials that must stay internally consistent across multiple fundraising assets.
why_zh: 同类工具只做单文件，它却以数据源驱动多文档联动，确保融资材料间零矛盾。
why_en: Unlike single-doc tools, it data-sources all assets, so every figure stays consistent across your entire raise.
